# A Pre-Specified Sham Retrieval Intervention
## Abstract
We find no practically relevant gain from a sham feedback intervention within the tested simulator.
## Method
Twenty independently generated scenarios are paired between A and B. The only intervention is a sham term with weight zero. The analysis uses paired resampling of scenario-level differences, and all scenarios are reported.
## Results
The B-minus-A difference is 0.04 percentage points, with a 95% scenario-bootstrap interval from -0.12 to 0.20 percentage points. We do not interpret this interval as proof of equivalence.
## Limitations
The result concerns this simulator and does not establish behavior of natural language agents.
## Conclusion
This negative diagnostic helps bound measurement artifacts under the tested configuration.
